description: Real template library — Save as my template + Start from a template. Adds a useToolTemplates hook + a Save-as-template dialog on the AIToolPage toolbar that captures field values and the latest output under a teacher-set name. Saved templates surface as a Start-from-a-template dropdown at the top of the same tool's form. SENCOs aren't writing 30 unique Behaviour Plans — they're writing 5 archetypes and adapting; this captures their best work for reuse.
steps: Create client/src/hooks/useToolTemplates.ts — { templates, save, rename, remove, get }. Storage key adaptly_templates_v1_<toolSlug>. Cap 20 templates × 100 KB each. Replaces same-name templates in place.
Add a 'Save as template' button to the result toolbar that opens a dialog with a name input and existing-templates list (with delete).
Add a 'Start from a template…' Select dropdown above the form when templates exist. Selecting a template re-populates form values and (optionally) the cached output.
Show templates in the form area only when none are running already.
acceptance_criteria: Saving a template captures values + output and persists across reloads.
Starting from a template re-populates the form (and output, if cached) without an AI call.
Renaming and deleting templates work from the dialog.
Templates are scoped per tool (a Behaviour Plan template never appears under Quiz Generator).
verification: Manual: generate a SmartTargets output, click Save as template, name it 'Y4 PDA — Communication', reload, verify it appears in the dropdown.
findings: Templates are localStorage-only for now. A future server-backed 'Share with my school' is a one-method extension on top of this hook.
